assessment: This paper is interesting, timely, and important because it presents a way to understand the transmission potential of a virus even when there are very few local cases. This has a high public health communication and preparedness value. The paper is clearly written, and the results fit with the known epidemiology of outbreaks that occurred in Australia in 2020. The results are convincing and likely to be of broad interest within and outside the field of epidemiological modelling.
